What is a mesh convergence study?

live.judge: Says in one to three short sentences what a mesh convergence study is (the same model solved at finer and finer meshes until the answer stops changing), from our theory pages; names no number of its own

questions.ask: whats the diference between max stress and tsai-hill

live.judge: Says that maximum stress checks each stress against its own strength alone while Tsai-Hill adds the stresses together in one index, so Tsai-Hill usually gives the lower factor; short and plain

questions.ask: how do I test a coupon?

live.judge: Says in a line or two what a coupon test is set up from here (a test, a material, a layup, a size and a load) and offers to set one up; starts nothing on its own

questions.ask: how is a wing spar sized?

live.judge: Says plainly that our theory pages do not cover sizing a wing spar yet; does not make up a method or a number, and does not offer to set up a wing

questions.ask: Is FEA better than a hand calc for this
questions.gap: search: no theory page says when a hand calculation is enough and when FEA is needed, so the answer declines (real-model check, 2026-11-20)

live.judge: Opens with the answer: a hand calculation (laminate theory) is enough for a flat laminate under even loads, and FEA is needed where the stress varies, at a hole, a grip or a change of shape; does not claim a number

questions.ask: can you set up a wing analysis?

answer.heading: Open FEA for a wing analysis?

live.judge: Says in a line what the ABD matrix is (how a laminate's forces and moments relate to its strains and curvatures), or points to the Laminate section for it; changes no row of the coupon and opens nothing on its own
Says in a line that Tsai-Hill judges a ply by its three stresses together against its strengths; writes no number; changes nothing
Says in a line that it is the loading at which the first ply reaches a failure criterion, and that it is not the coupon's ultimate strength; changes nothing
